items.text: Its legislators in the upper chamber withheld the votes needed to fund the government for 43 days to demand an extension of the expanded premium subsidies, ended the standoff with only a promise of a vote, and then all voted for a three-year extension that fell short of the votes it needed.

items.text: Its national platform, adopted before this period, pledges to make the expanded premium subsidies permanent and to extend public health coverage to the 2.8 million uninsured low-income adults left out of it, under 1 percent of residents. Its votes and its funding standoff in the period, listed above, affirm the first pledge.
The same platform rejects any cut to the public pension and pledges to raise its benefits by raising taxes on the highest earners.
